newsitem.title: USA: Pepsi sells California Pizza chain-NY Times.
newsitem.headline: Pepsi sells California Pizza chain-NY Times.

text.p: PepsiCo Inc agreed to sell its California Pizza Kitchen chain of restaurants to a New York-based investment fund, the New York Times reported.
Terms of the transaction were not disclosed, although according to the Times, industry executives with knowledge of the deal estimated the sale price to be $100 million.
Officials at PepsiCo, as well as at Bruckmann, Rosser, Sherrill & Co -- the New York-based fund -- were not immediately available to comment further.

California Pizza Kitchen, based in Los Angeles, operates 79 restaurants in 19 states and had revenue of $175 million last year, the Times said. PepsiCo bought a controlling stake in the chain in 1992 for an undisclosed price, the paper added.
In January, PepsiCo said it would seek buyers for its casual dining businesses, including California Pizza Kitchen.
PepsiCo has also said it plans to spin off its Kentucky Fried Chicken, Taco Bell and Pizza Hut fast-food operations as a publicly traded company before the end of the year.
